programs.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out
programs.desc: Susan tours the north of England, a land forever linked to Wallace and Gromit, sticking to Yorkshire, where stunning Dales scenery, friendly faces and surprising local traditions await.

programs.title: Inside The Tower of London: Building the World's Greatest Castle
programs.desc: Actor Jason Watkins and historian Tracy Borman explore the fascinating story of how the Tower grew into the impressive fortress complex we see today.

programs.title: Warship: Life in the Royal Navy
programs.desc: JJ Chalmers joins recruits preparing for the realities of war, including chemical attack. And a new helicopter pilot lands on the deck of a moving warship for the first time.

programs.title: The Murder of Muriel McKay
programs.desc: When 55-year-old Muriel McKay disappeared from her home in December '69 her family were thrown into a nightmare that would change their lives forever.

programs.title: Trauma Room One
programs.desc: A woman arrives in a critical condition after a devastating stroke. Meanwhile, surgeons must remove a tumour in 42-year-old Dayan's neck - without surgery he could face paralysis.

programs.title: Cause of Death
programs.desc: Tragically, a young man has taken his own life, leaving his family with a myriad of unanswered questions. The coroner's team are charged with guiding them through the process.
